不得在原文写明的同宫与被相照两种关系之外，另加别的关系类型。
不得把本条的凶星换成吉星来套用。
不得据此推断婚期或妻子人数。

bphs-97:santhanam:ch24:v19.exact_text: 19. If Dhan’s Lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the native will be addicted to others’ wives and he will be a doctor. If a malefic is related to the said placement by yuti with Dhan’s Lord, or by Drishti, the native’s wife will be of questionable character.
